_comment: Models to benchmark, smallest first. params_b drives routing: the router recommends the smallest model that passes a domain. Hand-maintained — no registry reports parameter counts reliably, and cloud models don't publish them at all.

_fields.key: agent_key as condor would configure it (provider:model)
_fields.params_b: parameter count in billions; null for cloud models, which sort last
_fields.tool_filter_mode: essential | moderate | full — omit to let _infer_tool_filter_mode() decide, which is what production does
_fields.notes: why this model is in the sweep

models.notes: Floor of the study. Expected to pass single-tool cases only.
Cheapest plausible candidate for advisory / general_consult.
First size that reliably handles multi-tool sequences.
Upper end of what fits a single consumer GPU.
Last local rung before tool_filter_mode goes full.
Cheap cloud baseline via the direct Anthropic API — the key the dashboard's Anthropic provider produces.
Quality ceiling, direct API. Also the default baseline model.
Same model via OpenRouter. Listed separately because it is priced at OpenRouter's rates, not Anthropic's.
Fallback recommendation when no local model passes a domain.
